proof_body:
by
  intro g U c a R n hU hsub hg hg0 ha
  have hR : 0 < R := Metric.pos_of_mem_ball ha
  have hne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, z - a ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz h
    have : z = a := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    subst this
    have h1 := mem_ball_iff_norm.mp ha
    have h2 := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
    linarith
  have hgd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, DifferentiableAt ℂ g z := fun z hz => hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hsub hz))
  have hgd' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) U := hg.deriv hU
  have hq : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => deriv g z / g z) (Metric.ball c R) := by
    apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
    rw [closure_ball c hR.ne']
    exact (hgd'.mono hsub).div (hg.mono hsub) hg0
  have e : Set.EqOn (fun z => deriv (fun w => (w - a) ^ n * g w) z / ((z - a) ^ n * g z)) (fun z => (n : ℂ) * (z - a)⁻¹ + deriv g z / g z) (Metric.sphere c R) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzb : z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R := Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz
    have h1 := hne z hz
    have h2 := hg0 z hzb
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w - a) ^ n) ((n : ℂ) * (z - a) ^ (n - 1) * 1) z := ((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const a).fun_pow n
    have hm := hp.mul (hgd z hzb).hasDerivAt
    simp only
    have hm' : HasDerivAt (fun w => (w - a) ^ n * g w) ((n : ℂ) * (z - a) ^ (n - 1) * 1 * g z + (z - a) ^ n * deriv g z) z := hm
    rw [hm'.deriv]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
      field_simp
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr hR.le e]
  have i1 : CircleIntegrable (fun z => (n : ℂ) * (z - a)⁻¹) c R := by
    apply ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hR.le
    exact continuousOn_const.mul (ContinuousOn.inv₀ (by fun_prop) hne)
  have i2 : CircleIntegrable (fun z => deriv g z / g z) c R :=
    (hq.continuousOn.mono (by rw [closure_ball c hR.ne']; exact Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall)).circleIntegrable hR.le
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_add i1 i2, hq.circleIntegral_eq_zero hR.le, circleIntegral.integral_const_mul, circleIntegral.integral_sub_inv_of_mem_ball ha]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (c a : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ), IsOpen U → Metric.closedBall c R ⊆ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, g z ≠ 0) → a ∈ Metric.ball c R → (∮ z in C(c, R), deriv (fun w => (w - a) ^ n * g w) z / ((z - a) ^ n * g z)) = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n
